title: Rustorio technology
description: content/techs/*.json — a node of the research tree.

label.description: A plain string, or an object of locale code to string. Falls back to "en", then to the id.

cost.description: Research points spent to unlock it.

items.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference.

prerequisites.description: Technologies that must be unlocked first. References only, resolved after every mod has loaded.

items.description: Bare name (this mod's own namespace) or a full namespace:path reference to a TechEffect.

effects.description: Gameplay effects granted while this technology is unlocked. References only, resolved after every mod has loaded.
